briefing.text: Demand for the next 12 months is forecast at 1,795,512 units (+5.4% vs the last 12 months) and $1.60 B revenue at the announced 2027 list prices; the 19-month total is 2.81 M units (P10 2.68 M - P90 3.17 M).
The market is in an upturn: orders over the last 3 months are +13.6% year on year against -0.6% over 12 months; peak months are Oct, Sep.
Relative to the market, Electrical Assemblies is outpacing and Chassis & Structural, Powertrain Components are lagging.
The EV shift continues: EV SKUs +26.2% next 12 months (share 9.8% -> 11.8%), ICE SKUs -4.9%.
6 family-region(s) are forecast above their highest 3-month volume shipped in the last 3 years; the largest gap is Chassis & Structural in Middle East & Africa at 105% from the window ending 2027-01.
Next procurement cycle (deliveries in the next 3 months): $558 M of supply at each segment's service level, of which $167 M is safety buffer above the median forecast.
1,736 A-class series carry 80% of next-year revenue; 317 series are hard to forecast (Z) and are planner-owned.
Macro risk: a combined downside (PMI -3, auto production -2 pp, orders -5%, raw materials +10%) cuts the 19-month forecast by 6.2%; the upside adds 3.9%.
58 critical actions this cycle; the top one: Demand shifting from ICE to EV - EV vs ICE (owner: S&OP / Product management).

top_recommendations.title: Demand shifting from ICE to EV
top_recommendations.finding: EV SKUs grow 26.2% next 12 months (share 9.8% -> 11.8%) while ICE SKUs change -4.9% (share 13.1% -> 11.8%).
top_recommendations.action: Shift capacity and procurement toward EV SKUs; set last-time-buy and run-down rules for declining ICE SKUs.
top_recommendations.trade_off: EV ramp risk vs ICE stranded inventory; revenue next 12 m: EV $247,637,096, ICE $207,434,951.

top_recommendations.title: Growing demand on a fragile supply base
top_recommendations.finding: Thermal Management in North America grows 3.6% next 12 months, but had 17 shortage months in 36 months (mostly Tooling breakdown), 577 lost units and a 39.3% average fill rate in those months.
top_recommendations.action: Raise safety stock to the segment's service level, qualify a second source or expedite option for the dominant cause, and review supplier performance before the next order release.
top_recommendations.trade_off: Higher buffer and dual sourcing add cost; $11,671,730 of revenue is due in the next 3 months.
